visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long, straight brown hair, natural makeup, and a soft gaze looks directly at the camera while her hands gently touch her hair to adjust it. She wears a brown off-the-shoulder long-sleeved top and khaki shorts with lace-up detailing. She carries a cream-colored drawstring bag with a gold chain strap. The background shows a sidewalk and street lined with trees under bright, natural daylight. (2) The woman begins walking along the sidewalk away from the camera, then turns her head back to smile broadly. In the background, a man in a light blue shirt walks in the opposite direction. The camera follows her movement at a medium distance. The street is wide with grey asphalt, and the lighting remains bright and natural, casting soft shadows on the ground. (3) She stops near a bus stop with a glass shelter and looks to her side before glancing back at the camera. A silver car and a person on a scooter pass by in the background street. She adjusts the shoulder of her top and her bag. The environment is a clean urban street with green trees and modern buildings in the far distance. (4) Close-up shots focus on her face as she poses, looking upwards and then tilting her head towards the camera with a subtle smile. She wears gold earrings and a delicate necklace. A white car is blurred in the background as it drives past. The lighting highlights her facial features and the texture of her hair against the outdoor background. (5) In a full-length shot, she stands on the sidewalk with her hands by her sides, then poses with one hand on her hip. A yellow taxi with 'Uber' branding and a black car pass behind her on the road. The sidewalk is paved with grey and brown tiles. She smiles at the camera, concluding her walk and pose sequence.
